indi_v6_hero.expr: Calm, a shy soulful gaze toward camera, small soft closed smile.

indi_v6_peek.expr: Shy PEEK from behind a wet black rock: upper head and eyes visible, one long arm curled softly over the top of her head, mouth a tiny shy line.

indi_v6_curious.expr: Curious and gentle, head tilting slightly, one arm reaching forward, mouth a small soft open 'oh'. NO teeth.
